newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dillon starts 2 drug delivery cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dillon starts 2 drug delivery cos.

text.p: -- Dillon Read said it started coverage of Elan Corp Plc with a buy rating and $50 per share 12-18 month price target and Alza Corp with outperform rating and $36 per share target.
-- Said views Elan "as the premier drug delivery company in the industry with a broad technology base that is truly global in scope."
-- Estimates Elan's earnings at $1.61 per share in 1997, $2.00 in 1998 and $2.55 in 1999.
-- Said Alza is "well down the road" in transition to "fully integrated specialty pharmaceutical company in which drug delivery technology will remain the core competency."
-- Estimates Alza's earnings at $1.20 per share in 1997, $1.44 in 1998, $1.80 in 1999 and $2.35 in 2000.
-- Alza shares fell 1/2 to 26. Elan was up 1/8 at 32-1/2.
